ilk_itemler.title: Global Financial Markets Confront the War in the Middle East and Amplification Risks
ilk_itemler.description: The global financial system is confronting the ongoing war in the Middle East, potential inflationary pressures, rising risks of further tightening in financial conditions, and several amplification channels that could lead from market turmoil to financial instability.

ilk_itemler.title: Global Financial Stability Report, October 2025: Shifting Ground beneath the Calm
ilk_itemler.description: Financial stability risks remain elevated amid risks presented by stretched asset valuations, growing pressure in sovereign bond markets, and the increasing role of nonbank financial institutions.

ilk_itemler.title: IMF Fiscal Monitor -- Fiscal Exit: From Strategy to Implementation; November 2010 -- Contents
ilk_itemler.description: November 2010: With increasing fiscal challenges in the aftermath of the global financial crisis, multilateral surveillance of fiscal developments, a key part of the IMF's surveillance responsibilities, has gained further importance.

ilk_itemler.title: World Economic Outlook, April 2026: Global Economy in the Shadow of War
ilk_itemler.description: The latest World Economic Outlook reports slowing global growth and renewed inflationary pressures. Policies need to be agile, carefully manage the trade-offs involved in ramping up defense spending, and lay the foundation for a sustained recovery.

- Finance & Development is the IMF's flagship magazine and online editorial platform that publishes cutting-edge analysis and insight on the latest trends and research in international finance, economics, and development.
- The print edition is published quarterly in English, Arabic, Chinese, French
Publication frequency, languages, and distribution

- Frequency: quarterly.
- Print edition languages: English, Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish.
- Web edition: supplemented with additional, online-only content.
- Subscription: free print subscription available; newsletter provides weekly analysis of the world economy.
